browserResult.scope: Controlled result records rendered by the shipped native result UI; native result, payout and prepare functions remain in charge. Isolated local server only.

resolvedFindings.description: SERVER待機 and JPCモード are absent from all four final result screenshots. The landscape first-row 12000 WIN and subtitle are unobscured.
The same two controls are absent from all four cut-in screenshots. Runtime assertions confirm both controls become visible again after the cut-in.

observations: The expected participating game logos, numeric WIN values and TOTAL are visible in each of the four cases.
The portrait ten-game and desktop one-game result rows and total are not clipped.
The ten-game landscape layout uses two columns of five horizontal rows.
All four cut-in screenshots contain the generated sweets artwork without floating button overlays.
visualReview.scope: Visual review of four final result screenshots and four cut-in screenshots from the verified CI artifact. This is not a real-device or audio-quality claim.

lateFirstPaintVerification.method: The real native finishRound/beginPayout/advancePayout methods enter the requested phase before the first result DOM. The real hud() paints synchronously; assertions inspect that exact first call without waiting for the decorative animation.

publicVerification.scope: Published asset hashes and frontend-ready rendering. Public game API and WebSocket traffic is intercepted locally; no session, BET, settlement or draw is sent.
